title: Question 22
passage:
The painter needs all the inside doors open, but I can't have the cat wandering from room to room.
A. I can keep the cat at my place while the painter's there. B. We could keep the bedroom door shut until the painter leaves. C. The painter said the front door can stay closed.
passageZh:
油漆師傅需要屋內所有的門都開著，但我不能讓貓在各個房間亂跑。
A. 師傅施工時，我可以把貓留在我家照顧。
B. 我們可以先關著臥室門，等師傅離開再開。
C. 師傅說大門可以保持關著。
